why: A language note printed after a bold label, as in "Miss Chan Choy Siong (Delta)(In Mandarin):", leaves the transcript and is kept in language_note as the words inside the brackets. The next paragraph of the same turn prints no note and keeps none.
title: WOMEN'S CHARTER BILL
html:
Sitting Date:06-04-1960
Title:WOMEN'S CHARTER BILL


Column: 1

WOMEN'S CHARTER BILL


    Question proposed.

    Miss Chan Choy Siong (Delta)(In Mandarin): Mr Speaker, Sir, regarding the Women's Charter which was introduced by the Minister for Labour and Law at the last Assembly sitting, I support the motion of the Minister.

    This Charter, as drafted has incorporated some of the provisions of a number of Ordinances.

    Miss Fung Yin Ching (Stamford)(In Mandarin): Mr Speaker, as one of the women of Singapore, I gladly agree with the stand adopted by the Government.
expected_rows: Mr Speaker, Sir, regarding the Women's Charter which was introduced by the Minister for Labour and Law at the last Assembly sitting, I support the motion of the Minister.
This Charter, as drafted has incorporated some of the provisions of a number of Ordinances.
Mr Speaker, as one of the women of Singapore, I gladly agree with the stand adopted by the Government.
